map.三项分别看什么？: What does each of the three items look at?
map.1 靠墙站立测头颈是否前伸代偿；2 肩部前倾观察是否圆肩；3 胸小肌长度（仰卧肩: 1 Stand against a wall to check whether the head and neck thrust forward to compensate; 2 look for forward shoulder tilt to check for rounded shoulders; 3 pectoralis minor length (do the scapulae lie flat when supine) reflects pectoral tightness. The three complement each other — a 3 in any one item signals a clear abnormality in that dimension.
map.测出圆肩怎么改善？: How to improve once rounded shoulders are detected?
map.轻度：每日胸肌拉伸（门框拉伸）+背部强化（划船、面拉）各 3 组×15 次；明显: Mild: daily chest stretching (doorframe stretch) plus back strengthening (rows, face pull), 3 sets × 15 reps each; obvious: systematic correction is needed, with daily chest stretching 2–3 times, strengthening the rhomboids and lower trapezius, adjusting posture, and consulting a rehabilitation therapist is advised.
